name: Project Dream
storyline: Dr. Eggman captures Cream the Rabbit and Cheese to use them as conduits for an ancient, dream-manifesting artifact called the Reverie, trapping himself and Sonic's crew inside a twisted dreamscape
summary: Project Dream is a community-developed native conversion wrapper that allows the macOS version of Sonic Dream Team to run natively on Windows and Android platforms. It utilizes the original game code without emulation or recompilation, including integrated support for the Unity Melon Loader modding framework.
